notes.title: Version 1.3.1 Released!
notes.content:
Fixed enemy killcount achievement acrual bug, 
The Summerschool achievement requires beating a level now, 
victory screen bug fixed, 
bug wit the light shocker attack FX fixed, and Solder and max life upgrade Quality of Life updates.

notes.title: Version update to Electron Flux 1.3.0
notes.content:
Version 1.3.0 introduces better UI scaling to fit different screens and aspect ratios, more keyboard shortcuts to allow for better play on Steamdeck, and introduces achievements! 
The research Now button updates UI more smoothly, and tutorial wording has been updated for clarity. 
We added the new Viral Lightning tower, and also patched unity.

Thank you to everyone who plays our game!

notes.title: Update version 1.2.1
notes.content:
Flightless Squid is proud to announce update version 1.2.1! Changes include:
+ A new tutorial page!
+ New late-game enemy with a trick up its sleeve!
+ New Game Over message
+ Game balance fixes
+ Minor UI tweak

From all of us at Flightless Squid, thank you so much for playing our game! Please stay tuned for more updates!
